book.name: Lɛme
book.title: Ŋwa wu Lɛme chi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso

content: Sol kusɛ wu lee fitele yi Jiso le
Gɛ̀ bee kife kɛɛ le, Sol baaŋ gɛh wu fuge, wu kaji bamii ba ŋgoo ba Tada lɛ wu lé wu yûuyɛ bo. Wu mo wu gɛɛŋ fɛ kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ le,

wu lɛgɛ lɛ wu nya wu baŋwa wu gɛɛŋ bɛ bo yéh yi buunɛ yi Damasku le, ba duunyi lɛ wu yɛŋ lo, no bamii ba yo bo bii Je yi Tada le mo nyu bikɛse, mo nyu bilɛŋsɛ, wu kooyɛ bo wu kaaŋ, wu to bɛ bo Yɛlusalɛm.
Wu nya, Sol ja wu gɛɛne Damasku, wu doo wu fɛɛse a kilaantɛŋ kɛɛ le, n'yuu wumu ja wu lalɛ fɛwe, wu shii ye ye le.
Wu gwe fɛkuu, wu yu jɛ jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Sol, Sol, wo boone bikaa a mɛ jiŋ nɛ nje la?”

content: Wu biih lɛ, “Tada, le wo wù yɛɛŋ?” Jɛ yiyu chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Le mɛ wù Jiso, le mɛ wù wo boone bikaa a mɛ jiŋ.
Yi mɛɛse le, ja we, wo lee wo gɛɛŋ a laantɛŋ, ba sɛɛŋ wo fiɛɛ fì wo kɛme ki wo gêe.”

content: Bamii ba gɛ̀ jiɛnyi bɛ ba Sol lɛɛŋ fo bo ŋgɛsɛ, no bo gɛ̀ yuge jɛ yiyu bo yɛde gɛ muh le gɛ.
Sol gɛ̀ ja we fɛkuu fɛɛ, lɛ wu doo wu gwenyɛ ajii, wu ka yɛde gɛ mwɛɛ le gɛ. Bo jijɛ wu yi kibo le, bo tu bo chiɛɛji wu bo gɛɛne bɛ wu Damasku.
Wu gɛɛŋ wu tu wù nyu yi aju le atade wu yɛde gɛ mwɛɛ le gɛ. Wu gɛ̀ bee noo, wu jii gɛ fiɛɛ gɛ, wu muu gɛ tɛ fiɛɛ gɛ.
Muh mbɛmɛ wumu gɛ̀ bee Damasku ayu jee che nyu lɛ Anania. Tada Jiso ja wu tɛɛŋ wu a fiɛɛ le njɛ kifilɛ le lɛ,
Wu bɛɛŋ lɛ, “Tada, nɛ mɛ wunɛ fɛnɛ.”
Tada jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Ja, wo gɛ̂ɛne a je yì ba tɛŋe lɛ Chaaŋ le, wo doo wo bu fɛ yeh yi Juda le, wo bii muh mu wu Tasu wu ba tɛŋe lɛ Sol. Yegɛ yu, wu le fo wu buune,
wu be wu yɛŋ wa muh mu a fiɛɛ le njɛ kifilɛ ba tɛŋe lɛ Anania, wu to wu gɛɛ chiaaŋ ye ye le, lɛ wu kaasɛ wu yɛde mwɛɛ le.”

content: Geenɛ, Anania jɛmɛ lɛ, “Tada, nle n'yu wa a bamii ba duude le kune muh wunɛ, no wù gee mwɛɛ mù mbefe fɛ bamii ba le ba Nyo le, ba Yɛlusalɛm le.
Wu too nɛ, wù nyu wu fi bvuŋga a bachiji bintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ le, lɛ wu to wu kooyɛ bamii bachii yanɛ bo buunɛ bo tɛŋe jee chuŋ.”
Tada chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛnɛ gɛh lo. Nle ncha wa muh wunɛ, muh waŋ wu lɛme le, lɛ wu fêeji jee chaŋ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ, bɛ banfoŋ baboo, mo bamii ba Ishwala le.
Mɛ kibɛɛ nlé ndunyɛ wu no wù kɛme ki wu yɛ̂ŋ ŋgɛ nje jee chaŋ.”

content: Noo, Anania mo wu gɛɛŋ, wu lee yeh yɛɛ le, wu gɛɛ chiaaŋ ye yi Sol le, wu tɛɛŋ lɛ, “Sol mwa bwaaŋ, tuŋ Tada Jiso mɛ. Le wu wù Jiso wù wo chi yɛŋ a je sege wo chi too yanɛ. Wu tuŋ mɛ lɛ, nto ŋge wo kaasɛ wo yɛ̂de mwɛɛ le, lɛ Kiyo ki Yuude to ki yisɛ ye yo le.”
Gɛh no wu jɛmɛ noo, fiɛɛ fimi njɛ bibagɛ mo bi bu a Sol jii bi gwe fɛkuu, wu mo wu tu wu yɛde mwɛɛ le. Wu ja we, bo mo bo leesɛ wu a joo.
Wu gɛ̀ ji mwɛɛ, bvuŋga kaasɛ bvu tu ye ye le. Sol fejɛ saaka wu Jiso Damasku Sol gɛ̀ che Damasku bɛ ŋgoo yi bamii ba mbɛmɛ, yi aju le shige,
wu mo wu kɛ lo kimimia wu tu wu jiɛnyi yéh yi buunɛ le, wu feeji lɛ, “Jiso le Mwa Nyo.”

Bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ yuge bo tu bo maŋe lɛ, “Wunɛ le gɛ muh wù chi jiɛnyi wu gɛɛne lo bɛ bamii ba buune bo tɛŋe jee chinɛ Yɛlusalɛm gɛ? Gɛ̀ wu to yanɛ nɛ ki wu kôoyi ba le yanɛ wu kaasɛ wu gɛɛne bɛ bo, wu nyaa chiaaŋ yi bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ le gɛ?”
Sol tu wu feeji gɛh fiɛɛ kune Jiso fi tɛɛme lo, wu duunyi lɛ Jiso le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka. Bajuu ba gɛ̀ bee Damasku bo ma lo fiɛɛ fì taŋlo bo chvuu wu le.
Aju gɛ̀ doo wo fe wesee, Bajuu bayu shii, bo chu ntaŋ ki bo yuuyɛ Sol.
Bo tu bo shiide, bo chiɛɛne wu jwe wu kitaŋ ki Damasku le, lɛ wu doo wu fede, kɛnɛ nyu antaŋ kɛnɛ nyu fɛnshɛ, ki bo yuuyɛ wu. Geenɛ, Sol kɛɛ ntaŋ wuboo.
Bamii be ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ jo wu antaŋ, bo leesɛ a ŋkaa le, bo bvusɛ wu fɛ nto wu kitaŋ le, bo shiishɛ wu fɛkuu wa akfuuŋ.
Sol gɛɛŋ Yɛlusalɛm
Sol tu jiŋ Yɛlusalɛm, wu doo wu goone ki wu tâashɛ bɛ ŋgoo yi bamii ba mbɛmɛ, bo tu bo faane lo wu, nje gɛ bo gɛ̀ bɛmɛ chuule lɛ wu le muh wuboo wu ŋgoo gɛ.
Geenɛ, Banaba jo wu, bɛ wu gɛɛŋ fɛ booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso le. Wu sɛɛŋ bo le no Sol gɛ̀ yɛŋ Tada le a je Tada jɛmɛ wu le, wu mo wu sɛɛŋ bo no wu gɛ̀ feeji kune Jiso Damasku wu faane gɛ.
Noo, Sol mo wu tu wù nyu bɛ bo wu jiɛnyi manjuu le manchii Yɛlusalɛm, wu feeji kune Jiso, wu faane gɛ.
Wu gɛ̀ jɛme tɛ Bajuu ba gɛ̀ jɛme jɛ yi Glek le, wu tɛɛnyi kintɛɛnyɛ bɛ bo, bo ja bo goone ki bo yuuyɛ wu.
Bamii ba mbɛmɛ kɛɛ lɛ bo goone ki bo yuuyɛ wu, bo mo bo jo wu bo boh bɛ wu a kilaantɛŋ ki Kasalia le, bo chiiŋsɛ wu gɛɛŋ Tasu.

Yi kife kinɛ le, kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ fufɛ shɛ́ŋ yi ŋgɛ le a bimbe bi woŋ wu Judia bɛ Galalee mo Samaliya le. Kiyo ki Yuude ge kintaashɛ kiyu ki tɛmɛ, ki mo ki tôone ŋgoo yɛɛ yi kuu. Bo tu bo chee, bo ŋgvuune gɛh nyu Tada.
Bita gɛɛŋ ntɛ wu Lida bɛ wu Joba le
Bita tu wu jiɛnyi, wu gɛɛne fɛ bamii ba le ba Nyo le manjuu le manchii, wu jiɛnyɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu bu fɛ bamii ba Lida le.
No wù gɛ̀ bee yo, wu yɛŋ muh mu le wu kwe kimbe kimimia, jee che nyu Ania wù nyu wu ge wa fɛnta biluŋ nyaaŋ.
No Bita yɛŋ wu le, wu tɛɛŋ lɛ, “Ania, Jiso Kletu fɛ wa wo. Ja we wo kɛnyɛ kinta kuŋ.” Kimimia Ania mo wu ja we.
Bamii ba Lida, mo ba yi bale yi Shaloŋ le, yichii mo bo yɛŋ no muh wuyu le wu tɛmɛ wa, bo leesɛ muntele yi Tada Jiso le.
Gɛ bee kwɛse wumu nyu a kilaantɛŋ ki Joba le, nyu muh wu mbɛmɛ, jee che nyume Tabita, chì le a jɛ yi Glek le lɛ Doka.
Wu gɛ̀ gee mwɛɛ mù njoŋe segechii, wu fii bamii ba fuude.
Lɛ nyume aju ayu le, kwɛse wuyu gwe kinchɛŋ, wu mo wu kwe. Bo chugɛ gvunɛ che, bo bɛɛŋ bo gɛɛ kimbe ki yeh ki awe le.
No Joba gɛ̀ bee mbebe yi Lida le, ŋgoo yi bamii ba mbɛmɛ yu lɛ Bita le Lida, bo mo bo tuŋ bilɛŋsɛ bafɛɛ fɛ wu le. Bo gɛɛŋ bo lɛgɛ wu, lɛ kii wu, lɛ wu to gɛh bikaa le.

Bita mo wu ja gɛh noo bɛ bo gɛɛne. Wu gɛɛŋ wu bu fo, bo jo wu bo bɛɛŋ bɛ wu kimbe ki yeh yi awe kɛɛ le. Bakwɛŋkfu ba yo bachii tuŋ kiŋgaŋ fo bo tu bo beede, bo duunyi njú yì Doka gɛ̀ fɛde sege wu gɛ̀ baaŋ yu.
Bita bvusɛ bo akfuuŋ bachii, wu tuŋ anyuu fɛkuu wu buunɛ, wu kaasɛ ye wu jɛmɛ gvunɛ chiyu le lɛ, “Tabita ja we.” Wu mo wu gwenyɛ ajii, wu bijɛ Bita, wu mo wu ja wu shii we.
Bita jijɛ wu yi kibo le, wu lɛɛŋ we. Wu kaasɛ wu tɛɛŋ bamii ba le ba Nyo bɛ bakwɛŋkfu baa, wu dunyɛ wu bo le, a wu kaasɛ wa wu tu yu.
Saaka wuyu saaŋe wu gɛɛŋ Joba achii. Bamii ba duude leesɛ muntele yi Tada le.
Bita tu wù nyu Joba yi aju a duude le, wu chee bɛ muh mu wù gɛ̀ kɛɛnyi jé, jee che nyu lɛ Samoŋ.

footnotes.text: Jee chi Tabita bɛ chi Doka le a jɛ yi Glek le nyu nyaŋ yi ba tɛŋe lɛ fikuna.
